While Airborne with full Class Ability Energy, activate [Air Move] to consume your Class Ability and quickly slam to the ground, dealing damage to all enemies within a 6? meter radius. Deals 50% increased damage in a 33?% bigger radius if you have a <void/>Void Buff (Devour, Overshield, Invisibility) active. 

Grants 5 seconds (7 with <void/>Echo of Persistence) of <void/>Void Invisibility if cast while already Invisible. 

Hits heal for ?HP, and kills grant <void/>Devour for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence).

When paired <void/><bold Vanishing Step /> Aspect: 
Trapper's Ambush adopts its former functionality and drops a <void/>Void Smoke Cloud upon landing. Enemies hit by the detonation of the Smoke Cloud are <void/>Weakened for <pve 10 /> <pvp [5] /> seconds, while allies are granted <void/>Void Invisibility for 6.5 seconds.

Trapper's Ambush triggers the effects of your equipped dodge upon consumption. Damage scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.
